# PatchSignal Dependency Security Audit API (x402 Enabled)

> Keyless, pay-per-request security vulnerability audit tool for autonomous software development agents.

## Endpoint
POST https://patchsignal-api-fixed.onrender.com/v1/audit

## Price
$0.005 per request via x402 on Base network (eip155:8453).

## Headers
Content-Type: application/json

## Request Payload Format
{
  "format": "dependencies",
  "dependencies": [
    {
      "name": "lodash",
      "version": "4.17.19",
      "ecosystem": "npm"
    }
  ]
}

## Response Format
Returns a JSON vulnerability report detailing known CVEs, severity levels, and recommended version upgrades.
